observation.visible_scene: A single horizontal row of eight small lit tea-light/oil lamps sits on a dark, glossy surface against a pure black background. From left to right the wax cups alternate between pale yellow and red, and the flames alternate between warm orange-yellow and a blue-violet base with a small orange tip. Directly beneath each lamp a vertical streak of light mirrors the flame on the reflective surface.
visible_changes: All eight flames flicker continuously: the height, width and tip shape of the orange-yellow flames (notably the 3rd, 4th, 5th and 7th lamps) vary subtly from frame to frame without the lamps moving.
The blue-violet flames (2nd, 6th and 8th lamps) also pulse slightly in size and brightness.
The vertical reflections below each flame elongate, shorten and brighten/dim in step with the corresponding flame flicker.
The lamps themselves stay fixed in position and spacing; the row remains centered in the frame with no observable translation, scaling or reordering of the candles.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the candles were recently lit or had been burning before the segment, and whether any flame goes out after the last frame.
The cause of the flicker (air currents, wick variation, etc.), which is not shown.
Anything happening outside the black background, including the room, light source or camera setup.
uncertain_details: The streaks below the lamps are interpreted as reflections rather than separate objects; this is consistent across frames but not independently verifiable.
No camera motion is detectable, but with a featureless black background a very small drift cannot be fully ruled out.
Fine color shifts within individual flames (blue base vs yellow tip) may partly be compression/rendering artifacts rather than true flame behavior.
